howToUse.title: How to Use
howToUse.description: Learn how to use the Hololive OCG Wiki to search for cards, build decks, and share with others.

introduction.title: Welcome to Hololive OCG Wiki
introduction.description: This comprehensive guide will help you navigate and make the most of the Hololive Official Card Game wiki. Whether you're a new player or an experienced duelist, you'll find everything you need to search for cards, build decks, and share your creations with the community.

basicSearch.title: Basic Search
basicSearch.description: Use the search bar at the top to find cards by name, ability text, or any other card information.

advancedSearch.title: Advanced Search Tips
advancedSearch.description: Make your searches more precise with these tips:
advancedSearch.tip1: Search works across all card text including abilities and flavor text
advancedSearch.tip2: You can search in multiple languages - the wiki supports Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, Korean, and Thai
advancedSearch.tip3: Search results update in real-time as you type

cardType.title: Card Types
cardType.description: Filter by specific card types to find exactly what you need for your deck:

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Filter cards by their color requirements. Select multiple colors to find multicolor cards:

rarity.title: Rarity
rarity.description: Find cards by their rarity level, from common cards to ultra rare treasures:

reset.title: Reset Filters
reset.description: Clear all active filters to start fresh:

creating.title: Creating Your First Deck
creating.step1: Click the 'New Deck' button in the deck panel at the bottom of the screen
creating.step2: Give your deck a name and optionally add your name as the author
creating.step3: Start adding cards by clicking on them in the card list - they'll be added to your active deck
creating.step4: Switch between Oshi, Main Deck, and Yell Deck tabs to organize your cards properly

deckTypes.title: Deck Types
deckTypes.oshi: Your Oshi Holomem - the star of your deck
deckTypes.main: Main deck cards including Holomems and Support cards
deckTypes.yell: Cheer cards that provide energy and support

management.title: Deck Management
management.edit: Edit deck name and author information
management.copy: Copy deck code URL to share with others
management.share: Generate shareable links for your decks
management.delete: Remove decks you no longer need

cardDetails.title: Understanding Card Details
cardDetails.description: Click on any card to view its detailed information. Each card shows comprehensive stats and abilities:

deckCodes.title: Deck Codes
deckCodes.description: Share your decks with others using generated deck code URLs:
deckCodes.copy: Copy deck code URL from the deck options menu
deckCodes.import: Import shared decks by visiting the deck code URL

localStorage.title: Local Storage
localStorage.description: Your decks are automatically saved in your browser's local storage.
localStorage.warning: Remember that decks are saved locally in your browser. Clear browser data will remove your saved decks, so consider backing up important deck codes.

performance.title: Performance Tips
performance.tip1: Use specific filters to reduce the number of cards displayed for better performance
performance.tip2: The search and filtering work in real-time - no need to press enter
performance.tip3: Enable compact mode for faster browsing of large card lists

shortcuts.title: Keyboard & Navigation
shortcuts.tip1: Use the search bar to quickly find specific cards
shortcuts.tip2: Click on card images to view high-resolution artwork
shortcuts.tip3: Use browser back/forward to navigate between card details and list view

mobile.title: Mobile Usage
mobile.tip1: The interface is fully responsive and works great on mobile devices
mobile.tip2: Tap and hold on cards for quick actions
mobile.tip3: Swipe gestures work for navigating between deck types

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.tip1: If cards aren't loading, try refreshing the page
troubleshooting.tip2: Clear your browser cache if you encounter display issues
troubleshooting.tip3: Make sure JavaScript is enabled for full functionality

footer.title: Ready to Start?
footer.description: Now that you know how to use the wiki, start exploring the amazing world of Hololive OCG!

status.title: Data Status
status.description: Card database status — which cards are new, updated, or missing from the official source.
status.removedNote: These cards were in the previous dataset but are no longer present in the source.
status.skippedNote: These cards exist in the source data but are missing required fields and cannot be added to the database.
status.fullModeNote: This report was generated in full mode. The New / Updated / FAQ / Removed columns reflect source-to-source diff and may be empty until the next incremental migration run.
